newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says against forced sackings at Foncier.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says against forced sackings at Foncier.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis reaffirmed on Tuesday that he was against any forced redundancies at bank Credit Foncier de France.
"In all cases, I'm against any forced redundancies," Arthuis said on France 2 television.
"If there are departures, and unfortunately there will have to be departures, they will be early retirements or voluntary redundancies. But no forced redundancies."

The government has proposed spinning off part of the business of troubled home loans group Credit Foncier into Credit Immobilier and winding down the rest. But it ran into stiff resistance from staff, unions and some politicians.
The government named former SNCF state railway head Philippe Rouvillois as mediator on Monday and he was due to meet the unions at 0930 GMT on Tuesday.
"I hope that Philippe Rouvillois will help the talks...to save jobs," Arthuis said.
